rootCauses: Generator renders spring.datasource but omits the existing cpf.domain.persistence enabled/provider/data-source-prefix contract, so CpfDomainDataSourceAutoConfiguration and CpfDomainMyBatisAutoConfiguration are both condition-negative.

CpfMyBatisConfig is the CPF platform/observability MyBatis owner for an explicitly named cpfDataSource, but is imported unconditionally and therefore fails every Generated business-only runtime that correctly has no platform cpfDataSource.

CpfDomainMyBatisAutoConfiguration uses a retired afterName package instead of the actual CpfDomainDataSourceAutoConfiguration class, leaving ordering vulnerable after the Generator contract is enabled.
Generated @MapperScan does not name cpfDomainSqlSessionFactory, leaving the business Mapper owner implicit when multiple platform session factories legitimately coexist.
preservedBoundaries: CUSTOMER_BUSINESS_DB remains distinct from optional CPF platform DB
Explicit sqlSessionFactoryRef for business Mapper scan
